prompt: I need a fake OpenAI-compatible LLM server running locally so I can hit /v1/chat/completions with curl and get a streaming response back. Get one up and confirm it's actually serving.

assertions.text: Launched aiperf-mock-rs with --no-tokenizer to avoid a Hugging Face download
Used --fast (or otherwise chose an instant-latency mode) for a quick smoke target
Actively verified the server responded (a successful /health curl or a real /v1/chat/completions response) rather than assuming it booted
